sections.content: Hungarian divides the day into specific meals: reggel (breakfast), ebéd (lunch), vacsora (dinner). Each meal is associated with different foods.

items.spanish: A reggeli egyszerű. Ebédre lesz leves és alma.
items.english: Breakfast is simple. For lunch there will be soup and apple.
For lunch there will be soup.

sections.content: 'Ebédre' (for lunch) uses the -ra suffix to show purpose/time. This is a common way to talk about what will happen at a particular meal.
